M-tron Industries, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

 

 

•

Revenues increased 11.1% to $15.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $14.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025

 

•

Gross margin increased 20 basis points to 44.5% for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to 44.3% for the three months ended September 30, 2025

 

•

Net income increased 66.4% to $3.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $1.8 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025

 

•

Net income per diluted share increased 16.7% to $0.70 for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $0.60 for the three months ended September 30, 2025

 

•

Backlog was $84.9 million as of September 30, 2026 compared to $76.4 million as of December 31, 2025

 

ORLANDO, Florida (November 12, 2026) — M-tron Industries, Inc. (NYSE American: MPTI) ("Mtron" or the "Company"), a U.S.-based designer and manufacturer of highly-engineered electronic components and solutions for the aerospace and defense, avionics, and space industries, announced financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026.

 

"Our third quarter results reflect the continued strength of demand across our defense and aerospace markets," said Cameron Pforr, Mtron Chief Executive Officer. "Revenue increased 11% compared to the third quarter of last year, and we expanded gross margin by 20 basis points. We are continuing to invest in our team and capabilities to support the growth opportunities we see ahead."

1

 

Results from Operations

 

Third Quarter 2026

Revenue was $15.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared with $14.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The increase was primarily due to strong growth in aerospace and defense, avionics, and space product shipments.

 

Gross margin was 44.5% for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared with 44.3% for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The increase was primarily due to product mix.

 

Net income was $3.0 million, or $0.70 per diluted share, for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared with $1.8 million, or $0.60 per diluted share, for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The increase was primarily due to the increase in gross margin discussed above and higher interest income earned on investments in money market mutual funds driven by higher balances invested.

 

The increase was partially offset by higher engineering, selling and administrative expenses driven by higher research and development investment, higher sales commissions consistent with the increase in revenues, higher stock-based compensation, and an increase in administrative and corporate expenses consistent with the overall growth in the business.

 

Adjusted EBITDA was $3.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared with $3.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The slight increase was primarily due to higher revenues and gross profit partially offset by higher general and administrative expenses.

 

Fiscal Year to Date 2026

Revenue was $45.5 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared with $40.2 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The 13.3% increase was primarily due to continued strong aerospace and defense and avionics product shipments.

 

Net income was $7.3 million, or $1.79 per diluted share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared with $5.0 million, or $1.64 per diluted share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The increase was primarily due to higher revenues and gross profit as well as higher interest income earned partially offset by higher engineering, selling and administrative expenses driven by higher research and development investment, higher sales commissions consistent with the increase in revenues, $918 of stock-based compensation related to 2025 bonuses, and an increase in administrative and corporate expenses to support the growth in revenues.

 

Adjusted EBITDA was $10.2 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared with $8.1 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The increase was primarily due to higher revenues and improved operating leverage.

 

Backlog

Backlog was $84.9 million as of September 30, 2026, an increase of 44.3% from $58.8 million as of September 30, 2025 and 11.0% from $76.4 million as of December 31, 2025. The increase in backlog reflects broad demand for our products including continued purchasing under several large aerospace and defense programs, the initiation of orders for new aerospace and defense programs, and a recent uptick in space industry orders.

About Mtron

 

M-tron Industries, Inc. (NYSE American: MPTI) designs, manufactures, and markets highly engineered, high reliability frequency and spectrum control products and solutions. As an engineering-centric company, Mtron provides close support to its customers throughout our products' entire life cycle, including product design, prototyping, production, and subsequent product upgrades. Mtron has design and manufacturing facilities in Orlando, Florida, and Yankton, South Dakota, a sales office in Hong Kong, and a manufacturing facility in Noida, India. For more information, visit www.mtron.com.

Non-GAAP Financial Measures

 

Throughout this press release, including the results from operations, the Company presents its financial condition and results of operations in the way it believes will be most meaningful and representative of its business results. Some of the measurements the Company uses are "Non-GAAP financial measures" under SEC rules and regulations. The non-GAAP financial measures the Company presents are listed below and may not be comparable to similarly-named measures reported by other companies. the reconciliations of such measures to the most comparable GAAP measures in accordance with Regulation G are included within the relevant tables attached to this press release. The presentation of this additional information is not meant to be considered in isolation or as a substitute for net earnings or diluted earnings per share prepared in accordance with GAAP.

 

The Company uses the following operating performance measure because the Company believes it provides both management and investors with a more complete understanding of the underlying operational results and trends and our marketplace performance

 

Adjusted EBITDA is derived by excluding the items set forth below from Income before income taxes. Excluded items include the following:

 

•

Interest income

 

•

Interest expense

 

•

Depreciation

 

•

Amortization

 

•

Non-cash stock-based compensation

 

•

Other discrete items that might have a significant impact on comparable GAAP measures and could distort the evaluation of our normal operating performance
